page.notes: Printed text is in Latin with long s throughout; transcribed as plain s and u/v adjusted per convention. "Cassander" is printed with a double-s ligature shaped like ff ("Caffander"), read as Cassander. The "Augustinus" entry carries a small mark before the name, not transcribed. The first word "pisse" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Word breaks keep their printed hyphens. The top edge shows no further running text.
